ecuparam.name: External Wideband Lambda (D2WD610H master)*
ecuparam.desc: Master-patch external-wideband lambda at FFFFB098. The former MAF ADC feeds both synthetic front feedback banks. A value of 0.0 is the firmware fault sentinel and must never be interpreted as a real lambda value.

ecuparam.name: External Wideband Input ADC (D2WD610H master)*
ecuparam.desc: Unsigned former-MAF ADC at FFFFAB06. Use counts/volts to compare the ECU input with the controller analog output and diagnose wiring, ground offset, clipping, or a controller fault; it is not itself lambda.

ecuparam.name: External Wideband Ready Metric (D2WD610H master)*
ecuparam.desc: Master-patch synthetic readiness metric at FFFFAE70. Firmware publishes 50.0 for a valid configured input and 0.0 for an invalid input. Closed-loop feedback requires this value to be greater than 35.0; EBCS duty requires it too, plus valid MAP/RPM/IAT, minimum control RPM, and a non-fault speed-density result.
